description: A leading global commercial real estate and investment management company, providing specialized real estate services for buyers, owners, and investors.

A prominent real estate development company in Costa Rica with a diverse portfolio of residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects. They are known for creating large-scale, master-planned communities.

A leading real estate developer in Central America with a strong presence in Costa Rica. They focus on the development, leasing, and operation of shopping centers, corporate offices, and mixed-use projects.

The Costa Rican office of the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, providing a broad range of integrated services, including facilities, transaction and project management; property management; investment management; appraisal and valuation.

A full-service law firm with a strong real estate practice. They advise national and international clients on all aspects of real estate law, including acquisitions, development, financing, and leasing.

A leading Central American law firm with a significant presence in Costa Rica. Their real estate practice group handles complex transactions, including project development, financing, and tourism-related projects.

A boutique real estate brokerage specializing in the sales of titled homes, land, and income-producing properties in the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica, specifically in the Punta Uva and Puerto Viejo areas.

A major international real estate franchise with extensive operations in Costa Rica. They offer a wide range of services including residential and commercial sales, luxury properties, land, and property management across the country.

A real estate company with affiliations for residential, commercial, and luxury properties. They offer services in brokerage, sales, property management, and vacation rentals, primarily focused on the Guanacaste region.
A real estate agency specializing in the sale of luxury homes, villas, and estates in prime locations throughout Costa Rica, with a focus on high-end, exclusive properties.

A global law firm with a strong presence in Costa Rica. Their real estate practice provides comprehensive legal services for investors, developers, and lenders, covering transactions, project finance, development, and more.
